scope.v2_v3: All 72 plan days, 12 cases; node-local selected-worker records only.
scope.v1: Only final case seed11, 5 plan days; selected-worker is global coordinator choice.
counterLimitations: improved is immediate receiver repair improvement, not final submission or match improvement.
sent counts queued optional packets, received counts accepted offer revisions; they are not comparable loss counters.

wire counters are cumulative application bytes per connection, not per-request bytes. Last worker completion log precedes final Result send, so case-end tx excludes that final Result. Network stack headers are excluded.
max_receiver_mailbox_age_ms is time since accepted revision arrived at local bus until receiver take, not LAN latency or publisher age. Median across daily maxima is not median offer latency.
Selected receiver with imports that day does not establish foreign-solution ancestry of selected best.
